# AccuracyCoin — NES accuracy test cartridge

**Upstream:** https://github.com/100thCoin/AccuracyCoin
**Snapshot:** 2026-11-04, commit `b037b4180fdf1c4d35898bc511afc1046a9e6737`
**License:** MIT (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)) — © 2025 Chris Siebert
**Taken:** `AccuracyCoin.nes` only (40976 bytes, sha256
`291e8572219a205aa96cc6c4376b1db26bdb1abc3ec63db38c0eefb067b729f8`), iNES, mapper 0
(NROM), 32 KiB PRG.
**Not taken:** the assembly source, the tile sheets, `nesasm.exe` — the ROM is built
upstream; nothing here rebuilds it.

A large set of NES accuracy tests on one cartridge, by the author of TriCNES (also in
the image). Staged as `\games\ACCURACYCOIN.NES`; both emulators open it
(`TRICNES.EXE`/`FAMI.EXE` with the path, or from its tile in the launcher).
